headline: Geopolitical Tensions and Ukrainian Strikes on Refineries Drive Fuel Prices
summary: Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian energy infrastructure and ongoing Middle East conflicts continue to influence global crude markets and drive up fuel prices.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity whose price movements directly affect inflation, transportation costs, and energy sector revenues worldwide.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Disruptions to refining capacity and regional security risks tighten petroleum supplies, lifting fuel prices.

why_moved: Supply concerns stemming from active conflict zones fueled upward pressure on international energy benchmarks.
